answer: Body text needs a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 under 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum), which is level AA. Under 1.4.6 Contrast (Enhanced), level AAA, it needs at least 7:1.

points.text: For level AA, text and images of text need a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, unless they are large text.
points.quote: has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1
points.title: 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)
points.source_text:
The visual presentation of text and images of text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, except for the following:
Large Text:
Large-scale text and images of large-scale text have a contrast ratio of at least 3:1;
Incidental:
Text or images of text that are part of an inactive user interface component, that are pure decoration, that are not visible to anyone, or that are part of a picture that contains significant other visual content, have no contrast requirement.
Logotypes:
Text that is part of a logo or brand name has no contrast requirement.

points.text: Large-scale text only needs 3:1 at level AA, so body text does not qualify for that lower ratio.
points.quote: Large-scale text and images of large-scale text have a contrast ratio of at least 3:1

points.text: For level AAA, the required ratio rises to 7:1 for text and images of text.
